gaps.valueSet: Uncoded suspected-measles, Koplik-spot, laboratory-panel, and epidemiologic branches
gaps.reason: the authoritative source reports no codes for suspected-measles ICD-10-CM, Koplik-spots ICD-10-CM, measles culture and antigen panels, exposure and increased-risk ICD-10-CM, or four free-text epidemiologic criteria; the corresponding rules retain their coded alternatives

gaps.valueSet: Four-fold measles IgG rise and ratio threshold
gaps.reason: source rules 3 and 13 include paired-specimen timing and quantitative IgG comparison logic that is explicitly not implemented in RCKMS and cannot be represented by SEM_V1; both rules retain the coded IgM test-order branches
SEM_V1 cannot compare body-temperature values against 38 degC or 100.4 degF, so source rules 13 and 14 retain the coded fever diagnosis and active-problem branches but omit the vital-sign branch
